title: 排错：这颗 LED 为什么不亮？
summary: 面包板上已经有一个搭错的电路，里面藏着 3 处错误。按顺序查，把它修好。
description: 一个最简单的 LED 电路（+9 V → 470 Ω → 红色 LED → GND），但 LED 不亮，面包板上的电路里有 3 处错误。按“电源 → 沿电流路径走一遍 → 极性 → 回路”的顺序查找并修好。

cards.title: 它不亮
text: 面包板上已经摆好了一个电路，**LED 不亮**。先别急着拔元件，看一看、摸一摸（把鼠标停在孔上，看哪些孔相通）。
你能找到几处不对？

cards.title: 排错四步
text: 1. **先看电源**：+ 和 − 是不是接到了正确的轨道？
2. **沿着电流的路走一遍**：从 + 出发，每经过一个元件，确认它的两只脚在**两条不同的金属条**上。
3. **查有极性的元件**：LED、二极管、电源的方向对不对？
4. **确认能回家**：电流最后能不能回到 −（GND）？
![](fig:path)
小技巧：打开工具栏的**结点着色**——同一颜色就是同一个结点。

cards.title: 一处一处修
text: - 每修好一处，看看诊断有没有变化。
- 三处都修好，LED 就会亮。然后点「检查我的电路」。

cards.title: 带走
text: - 排错要**有顺序**：电源 → 路径 → 极性 → 回路。乱拔乱插只会制造新问题。
- 有了万用表，还可以一列一列量结点电压：电压在哪里“断崖式”变化，问题就在哪里。
- 这三种错误（脚插在同一列、LED 插反、没接回 GND）是新手最常见的三种，以后自己搭电路时先查它们。

caption.text: 排错顺序：① 电源接对轨道 ② 沿电流的路走一遍，每个元件跨在两条金属条上 ③ LED 方向对 ④ 最后能回到 −。

i18n.en: Debugging order: ① the supply on the right rails ② walk the current path, every part spanning two strips ③ the LED the right way round ④ a way back to −.

en.title: Fault-finding: why won't this LED light?
en.summary: A broken circuit is already on the board with 3 faults hidden in it. Check in order and fix it.
en.description: The simplest LED circuit (+9 V → 470 Ω → red LED → GND), but the LED stays dark: the circuit on the board has 3 faults. Find and fix them in the order supply → walk the current path → polarity → way home.
hints: Don't pull anything yet. Turn on node colours (one colour = one node) and walk the current path from +9 V: does every part have its two legs on two different colours?
Then the polarised part: the LED's long lead (anode) should face where the current comes from. Finally check that the current can get from the LED all the way back to the blue − rail.
Still missing some? The three faults are: where the resistor's legs are, which way the LED points, and the connection from the LED's cathode column to GND.

cards.title: It won't light
text: A circuit is already on the board and **the LED is dark**. Don't start pulling parts yet — look first (hover over holes to see which ones are connected).
How many problems can you spot?

cards.title: Four steps of fault-finding
text: 1. **Supply first**: are + and − on the right rails?
2. **Walk the current path**: start at + and, at every part, check that its two legs sit on **two different metal strips**.
3. **Check polarised parts**: are the LEDs, diodes and supplies the right way round?
4. **Make sure it gets home**: can the current get back to − (GND)?
![](fig:path)
Tip: turn on **Node colours** in the toolbar — one colour is one node.

cards.title: Fix them one at a time
text: - After each fix, see whether the diagnostics change.
- With all three fixed the LED lights. Then press Check my circuit.

cards.title: Take away
text: - Fault-finding needs **an order**: supply → path → polarity → way home. Random plugging and unplugging only makes new problems.
- With the multimeter you can also measure node voltages column by column: where the voltage falls off a cliff is where the problem is.
- These three faults (both legs in one column, an LED backwards, no way back to GND) are the three most common beginner mistakes — check for them first in your own circuits.

measurements.ask: The three faults you fixed were:
choices: The resistor's legs in one column (shorted), the LED backwards, the LED's cathode not connected back to GND
The battery backwards, the wrong resistor value, the wrong LED colour
A jumper too long, the LED too dim, a flat battery
measurements.explain: The resistor sat in b5 and d5 (one column, shorted by the strip); the LED's long lead faced the GND side; the LED's cathode column had no jumper back to the − rail.

choices: 电阻两只脚在同一列（被短路）、LED 插反了、LED 负极没有接回 GND
电池接反了、电阻阻值错了、LED 颜色错了
跳线太长、LED 太暗、电池没电
measurements.explain: 电阻插在 b5、d5（同一列，被金属条短路）；LED 长脚朝向了 GND 那边；LED 负极那一列没有跳线回到 − 轨。

hints: 先不要急着拔元件。打开结点着色（同一颜色 = 同一结点），从 +9 V 出发沿电流的路径走一遍：每个元件的两只脚是不是落在两种不同的颜色上？
再看有极性的元件：LED 的长脚（阳极）应该朝向电流流来的一侧。最后确认电流能从 LED 之后一路回到蓝色 − 轨。
还没找全？三处错误分别在：电阻两只脚的位置、LED 的方向、LED 负极那一列到 GND 的连接。
